text:
JSON::create
Description
This command creates a new, empty JSON cache instance. It can then be filled with any JSON content
and rendered. It will be deleted when no longer referenced by a Tcl variable.
Syntax
JSON
::
create
JSON::create
Returns the new JSON cache instance.
Examples
when
JSON_REQUEST
{
set
cache
[
JSON
::
create
]
set
rootval
[
JSON
::
root
$cache
]
JSON
::
set
$rootval
string
HelloWorld
set
rendered
[
JSON
::
render
$cache
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
